svg.title: DreamCarve phase 4 wireframe: V-Carve and Inlay editors
svg.text: 06 · Operation editors: V-Carve with clearing passes (68, 70); Inlay with one set of values for both sides (68a), shown on the female.
Cut before the V-bit, largest tool first; each is its own tool run.
next smaller end mill is picked
deepest cut 2.5 mm · flat floor, cleared by T1 then T2
⚠ clearing_not_descending would show here if T2 were above T1
Save As <stem>-male.dcv, side flipped, thickness asked
▾ Depth · one set for both sides
Dimmed: set here, used by the male.
male start plane 3 mm · band floor 5 mm below the stock top
flank engagement 5 mm > cone height 3.175 mm (90° bit)
Every field shows whichever side is chosen; the label says who
reads it. The female reads only the inlay depth. Male fields stay
editable on the female so the values are set once and travel
with the file. On Male the dimming swaps: nothing is female-only.
Mirroring: inlay_male_mirrored at X = 55 mm, in the Warnings panel.
